text:
For an iPhone 17, choose between a **5,000 mAh bank** (thinnest, about a 60–75% top-up) and a **10,000 mAh Qi2.2 bank** (thicker, but charges at the iPhone 17's full 25 W wireless speed and can recharge it about 1.5–2 times).

## Top picks

**1. Best overall slim 10K: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2 25 W)**
- 0.5 in thick and 195 g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe-style bank it has tested.
- 25 W wireless, 45 W wired, a battery display, and an included 60 W lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- About $42.99–$54.99. Android Central found it for $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU.
- No kickstand.
- Sources: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**2. Best capacity in a slim 10K: Ugreen MagFlow Pro (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2 25 W)**
- Also tied for slimmest 10K in Macworld's testing.
- It had the best recharge score of any bank Macworld tested.
- 25 W wireless, 45 W wired, and a built-in USB-C cable. It comes in colors that match the iPhone 17 lineup.
- About $59.99 on Amazon.
- Sources: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**3. Thinnest real Qi2 bank: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- 0.34 in (8.6 mm) thick and 122 g, about as thin as an Apple Pencil.
- Qi2 at 15 W, and it runs cool. 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- $54.99, with $5 off at Anker right now.
- Buy: [Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim) at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**4. Slim 5K alternative: ReelCharge ReelSafe (5,000 mAh, Qi2 15 W)**
- 0.35 in thick and 119 g.
- Semi-solid-state battery, which is more durable and safer, plus an LED display.
- $49.99.
- Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Also worth a look: Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2 25 W, 45 W wired)**
- Regular price is $59.99 at Baseus. A deal site reports that code **AM52** took off $6 (to $53.99) when they tested it in Baseus's cart on Oct 24.
- The listing doesn't give thickness, so I can't confirm it's as slim as the INIU or Ugreen.
- Link: [Baseus PicoGo AM52 via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission.

## Skip if you want fast charging
The **Baseus Picogo Air AM71** is the thinnest of the group at 0.27 in and 104 g. However, it charges wirelessly at only 7.5 W, not Qi2 speed, and costs about $52.99–$69.99.

## Bottom line
- **Most people:** INIU SnapGo Air, for full 25 W speed and 10K capacity at a good price.
- **Thinnest pocketable option:** Anker Nano 5K Slim.

I only had a direct store link for the Anker. For the INIU, Ugreen, and ReelCharge, use the retailer links in the cited reviews or search the model name on Amazon.
